findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed member of staff to turn off hand sink without the use of a barrier. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper hand washing. Ensure when washing hands a barrier is used to turn faucet to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed a floor drain in front of triple sink to be missing cover. Discussed with PIC, drain cover will be purchased. Ensure all floor drains are properly covered.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas to be leaking:
1) The mop sink faucet is observed to be leaking. 

Discussed with PIC, leaks will be repaired. Ensure all plumbing repairs are completed by a licensed plumber, and that no leaks are present throughout facility. 

5-202.11: (A) A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to LAW. (B) A PLUMBING FIXTURE such as a HANDWASHING SINK, toilet, or urinal shall be EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed no certified food manager to be present during inspection. Discussed with PIC, PIC’s certified food manager license expired 9/1/24. Ensure a certified food manager is present during all hours of operation. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Observed multiple utensils hanging from shelving unit above triple sink to be in contact with wall. Discussed with PIC, utensils will be put through the wash, rinse, and sanitize process and will be properly stored in a way that prevents contamination. 

4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) Observed no active sanitizer bucket while food was being prepped and made. Discussed with PIC. Ensure a sani bucket is made prior to food manipulation. PIC made a bucket for Inspector. Facility has bleach to verify concentrations. Bleach - 200 ppm. Repeat violation since last routine inspection on 12/19/22. COS.

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the bottom prep cooler drawers to be soiled with food debris on the outsides and inside of cooler. Discussed with PIC, cooler will be cleaned. Ensure all non food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevent food accumulation. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.comment:
Observed the hood system to be soiled with grease and dust accumulation. Discussed with PIC, staff routinely cleans hood system monthly however a hood cleaning service is needed. Ensure hood system is cleaned at a frequency that prevents grease and dust accumulation. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Observed no food handler’s licenses for the facility. All food handling employees should have a valid food handler’s licenses. Valid for 3 years. Employees should obtain a food handler’s license within 30 days of employment. Discussed with PIC. Correct by next routine inspection.

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following areas of the facility that are in need of repairs:
1. The floor to the right of the prep cooler was observed with damaged tiles.
2. The floor in front of the back door has similar damage observed (tiles), as well as behind the oven.
3. The floor cover is missing for the drain in front of the 3 compartment sink.
4. Floor coving is missing throughout the facility (falling down).
5. The wall by the back reach-in cooler/freezer has dry wall damage, as well as in the bathroom and next to the desk.

Discussed repairs with PIC. #1-4 are repeat violations since the last routine inspection on 12/19/22. Ensure repairs by next routine inspection.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

Observed no food handler’s licenses for the facility. PIC is a CFPM. Other employees should have a valid food handler’s licenses. Valid for 3 years. Employees should obtain a food handler’s license within 30 days of employment. Discussed with PIC. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

An employee was observed to wash hands and not use a clean barrier to turn off the faucet. Education conducted and hands rewashed to remedy the violation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. 

On arrival the hand sink in the main prep area is observed with multiple rags stored in it. PIC was consulted and the rags removed during the inspection to correct the violation. Hand sinks should be only used for hand washing, not storage of old/used rags.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

On arrival as well as when foods had begun to be prepped, no sanitizers were available for use in the facility. Two sani buckets were made during the inspection using bleach to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

1) The floor to the right of the prep cooler is observed with multiple locations of damaged tiles allowing for rough surfaces that are not easily maintained clean. 2) the floor in front of the back door has similar damage observed. Repair prior to the next routine inspection. 3) The floor cover is missing for the drain to the left of the oven as well as the drain in front of the 3 part sink. Repair/replace and maintain functional grates.

6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED. 

Floor coving is observed pulling away from the wall at multiple locations throughout the facility. Repair and maintain repaired moving foreword.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

On arrival, the PIC was unaware of any documentation to which employees had been informed of their reporting responsibilities in relation to symptoms or diseases related to food born illnesses. Enough SCDPH reporting agreements were given to the PIC during the inspection to cover all current employees and an extra for copies/ future employees. PIC is instructed to ensure that each employee signs an agreement prior to the follow up date.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The magnetic strip above the three part sink is observed heavily rusted. PIC is instructed to replace or in some other way seal so that the item is smooth and easily cleanable.
